project: Circadian - Verizon Smart Campus Innovation Challenge 2026-27 (Rutgers)

champion_thesis.name: Circadian: one campus forecast, three paychecks
champion_thesis.one_liner: Timetable + event calendar + aggregate device counts (campus Wi-Fi indoors, Verizon at venues/outdoors) -> a 30-minute occupancy forecast per building that pays the campus (ventilation by headcount, comfort-safe setback, demand response, slices), Verizon (event-day energy saving without manual event mode; intent-aware triage) and students (navigator, guaranteed service).
champion_thesis.redteam_estimate_round1: 66-71/95 as originally pitched; 'probable winner' with the Gen-2 reframe

evidence.baseline: traffic-history AI + learned margins + manual event mode; same planner, guard and margin learner as Circadian
retracted: HVAC comfort metric that could not fail

open_weaknesses: All occupancy data is synthetic; the forecaster has never seen a real Juniper Mist count.
Network pull-through ($250k/customer/yr) is unvalidated and decides whether NPV is positive.
How Verizon runs event mode today is unknown; it sizes the network benefit.
Cell reactivation latency is an estimate (5-15 min); measure on COSMOS / Weeks Hall.
Triage dispatch and remote-fix probabilities are assumptions, not Verizon data.
next_actions: Ask the Verizon mentor the five questions in deliverables/ACTION_PLAN.md (drop-in Oct 20, 3-5 PM).
Walk-test and film the Oct 31 Michigan game; add measured stadium data to the dossier.
Request 4 weeks of Mist association counts for 5 buildings; retrain and re-run demand_skill on real data.
Price Layer 4 with Verizon Business; update pull_through_arr.
Generation 3: try a gradient-boosted or ST-GNN forecaster against the ridge baseline once real data exists.
